fields.subject: Shard Targeting Values
fields.trigger: ShardsValues: a caller constructs it via the ShardsValues(IList<short> list) constructor with a non-null list of shard identifiers, which may be empty
fields.response: initialize its Shards dictionary and add one shard with an empty parameter set for each distinct identifier in the list, ignoring repeated identifiers
fields.postcondition: the collection is immediately usable and its Shards dictionary holds exactly the distinct identifiers from the list
